disclaimer: Neutral comparison compiled by SmartyPOS (a Syrve partner - not independent). Competitor facts are from public vendor pages and reviews as of 2026-11 and change often; verify on the vendor's site before deciding. Items marked [verify] are unconfirmed.

syrve_smartypos.software: $59 / $99 / $129 per terminal per month (Counter / Service / Group)
syrve_smartypos.processing: No processor lock-in; rate quoted on demo
syrve_smartypos.hardware: Hardware-agnostic (iPad, Android, standard POS terminals, Epson/Star printers)
syrve_smartypos.api: Open API with read AND write access for the restaurant; private MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT
syrve_smartypos.inventory: Recipe costing / inventory to ingredient level included

toast.name: Toast
toast.summary: Largest restaurant-specific POS in the US (about 17% of small restaurants per Baird, Jan 2026). Strong all-in-one restaurant product with Toast Payments.
toast.software: From $0 (higher processing rate) / $69+ per month; add-ons priced separately
toast.processing: About 2.49%+15c to 3.09%+15c depending on plan (per public pricing reviews)
toast.contract: Toast Payments is required (no third-party processor); typical 2-3 year contracts with early-termination fees (per public reviews)
toast.hardware: Proprietary hardware, roughly $1.1-1.2k per kit (per public reviews)
toast.api: Standard API for restaurants is read-only (GET); write access only for approved partners. Toast declined write access for a single location (SmartyPOS first-hand, 2026-07-12). Guest phone in orders needs guest.pi:read scope gated by Toast approval.
toast.ai: ToastIQ (May 2025), Toast IQ assistant (Oct 2025, US), AI agents for scheduling/voids.
other: Inventory/recipe costing is a separate product (xtraCHEF, about $149-279/location/month per public pricing pages).
Customer-facing $0.99 online ordering fee introduced (Restaurant Dive).
Marketing automations: max 1 email per 28 days (SmartyPOS first-hand).
Full guest list only via manual CSV export (SmartyPOS first-hand).
toast.where_it_fits: Toast is a good fit for restaurants that want a single vendor for POS + payments, a large partner ecosystem, and do not need their own write API.

clover.name: Clover
clover.summary: Fiserv-owned; the largest share among small restaurants (about 20%, Baird Jan 2026). Flexible, app-marketplace model.
clover.contract: Fiserv processing; up to 36 months via resellers (per public reviews)
clover.api: Merchant API token with read/write via Clover developer platform.
clover.ai: Not a core differentiator in public materials [verify].
other: Restaurant features (recipe costing, central kitchen) are thinner than restaurant-specific platforms per public reviews.
clover.where_it_fits: Clover fits small counter-service and retail-like venues that want low entry cost and a large app marketplace.

square.name: Square for Restaurants
square.summary: Easy start, free tier, month-to-month, strong for small venues (about 13% share, Baird Jan 2026).
square.ai: Guests can order from ChatGPT/Claude since 2026-07-01 (Square press release).
other: Deep restaurant back-office (recipe costing to ingredient level, central kitchen) is limited compared with restaurant-specific suites per public reviews.
square.where_it_fits: Square fits small restaurants and cafes that value simplicity, no contract and a free entry plan.

spoton.name: SpotOn
spoton.summary: Restaurant and hospitality POS bundled with SpotOn payments.
spoton.where_it_fits: SpotOn fits venues that want bundled payments and hospitality-specific hardware.

lightspeed.name: Lightspeed K-Series
lightspeed.summary: Restaurant POS popular with full-service and hospitality groups, iPad-based.
lightspeed.contract: Annual; $399/month if you use a third-party processor
lightspeed.where_it_fits: Lightspeed fits full-service venues wanting an iPad-based floor experience and retail/hospitality combination.

touchbistro.name: TouchBistro
touchbistro.summary: iPad restaurant POS for full-service venues.
touchbistro.processing: TouchBistro Payments; third-party allowed with limited reports
touchbistro.where_it_fits: TouchBistro fits independent full-service restaurants wanting simple iPad ordering.

skytab.name: Shift4 SkyTab
skytab.summary: Free-hardware model funded by a processing contract.
skytab.contract: Long processing contract; hardware returned on exit (per public reviews)
skytab.where_it_fits: SkyTab fits venues prioritizing zero upfront hardware cost and accepting a processing contract.
